subject: English
passage: Most mammals are born live rather than hatching from eggs. This reproductive method, called viviparity, is one of the defining characteristics of the mammal class. However, not all mammal species give birth to live young. Platypuses, ______ lay eggs like reptiles and birds.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. "For instance" logically signals that the information in this sentence—that platypuses lay eggs like reptiles and birds—is an example supporting the claim in the previous sentence (that not all mammal species give birth to live young).
